tools.name: stg_inspect_media_url
tools.description:
Measure a rendered image or video at a public https URL (max 32 MB / 60 s / 1080p): blur, exposure, black and
        frozen frames, flicker, cuts, impacts and colour/lighting drift against reference_image_url. Uses 1 check.
        Returns a JSON report plus review frames to check for anatomy/ident

tools.name: stg_qa_gate
tools.description:
PASS / NEEDS_VISUAL_REVIEW / RETRY_SAME_MODEL / SWITCH_TO_FALLBACK / HALT / HALT_BUDGET with concrete fixes.
        Stateless: pass earlier attempts for this shot in shot_history (each result's record_this_attempt). Free.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "stg_inspect_media_url" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Measure a rendered image or video at a public https URL (max 32 MB / 60 s / 1080p): blur, exposure, black and frozen frames, flicker, cuts, impacts and colour/l…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
